# Nationwide Children's Hospital

> Comprehensive pediatric hospital and research institute providing clinical care, medical specialties, and family resources for children's health and wellness.

Nationwide Children's Hospital is a major pediatric medical center headquartered in Ohio with locations including Toledo, offering a wide range of clinical specialties, research programs through the Abigail Wexner Research Institute, and patient-centered services including telemedicine and online second opinions. The hospital is recognized for quality and safety initiatives through its Center for Clinical Excellence and maintains high rankings from U.S. News & World Report and other leading health organizations.

## Core Hospital Services

- [Nationwide Children's Hospital](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org): Homepage for Nationwide Children's Hospital, major pediatric hospital and research institute
- [Schedule an Appointment](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/schedule-an-appointment): Online appointment scheduling with providers via MyChart and Physician Direct Connect
- [Find a Doctor](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/find-a-doctor): Provider search directory and specialty finder for Nationwide Children's physicians
- [Specialties](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/specialties): Directory of medical specialties and services at Nationwide Children's Hospital
- [Online Second Opinions](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/online-second-opinions): Online second opinion program for remote medical consultation with hospital experts

## Medical Specialties

- [ENT (Otolaryngology) Services](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/specialties/ear-nose-throat-ent-services-otolaryngology): ENT specialty services including ear tube surgery and airway reconstruction

## Conditions & Treatment

- [Conditions We Treat](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/conditions): Directory of pediatric conditions treated at Nationwide Children's Hospital
- [Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/conditions/attention-deficit-hyperactivity-disorder): Medical information about ADHD symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment options
- [Atrial Septal Defects](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/conditions/atrial-septal-defect): Medical reference for congenital heart defects including ASD types and treatments
- [Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (BPD)](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/conditions/bronchopulmonary-dysplasia-bpd): Medical information on BPD chronic lung disease in premature infants
- [Epilepsy](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/conditions/epilepsy): Medical reference for epilepsy causes, seizure types, diagnosis, and treatment
- [Hirschsprung Disease](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/conditions/hirschsprung-disease): Medical information on Hirschsprung disease congenital bowel condition

## Patient & Family Resources

- [MyChart](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/family-resources-education/mychart): Patient portal for accessing medical records, appointments, and billing at Nationwide Children's
- [NICU Resources](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/family-resources-education/health-wellness-and-safety-resources/resources-for-parents-and-kids/nicu-resources): Guide and resources for NICU parents on newborn care and hospital discharge

## Professional & Institutional

- [For Medical Professionals](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/for-medical-professionals): Resources for healthcare professionals including referrals, education, and clinical tools
- [The Center for Clinical Excellence](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/impact-quality): Center for Clinical Excellence quality improvement and patient safety initiatives at hospital
- [Research](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/research): Abigail Wexner Research Institute pediatric research centers and clinical studies overview
- [Careers](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/careers): Career opportunities and job openings at Nationwide Children's Hospital

## Optional

- [Giving - Nationwide Children's Hospital Foundation](https://www.nationwidechildrens.org/giving): Donation and fundraising page for Nationwide Children's Hospital Foundation
